item.title: Patriots come up big on Senior Night
item.description: TOWNSEND — On the strength of a 27-point performance from senior captain Nolan Lyle, the North Middlesex Regional boys basketball team celebrated Senior Night with a 66-52 win over visiting Monty Tech. The Patriots, who are postseason bound for the first time in 10 years, finish the regular season 11-9, while the Bulldogs fall to 4-14 on the campaign and will visit Quabbin Regional on Wednesday evening.
